capture.title: Title of the dialog. Capture sits between an app and its API and records the calls.
capture.limitation: Explains that only apps that can be pointed at the local address are recorded.
capture.upstreamPlaceholder: The address of the real API; https://api.example.com stays as written.
capture.portTitle: 127.0.0.1 is the local address and stays as written.
capture.listening: {{address}} is the local address of the capture proxy.
capture.failed: Short badge shown instead of a status code when a call failed.
capture.sides: Choice between the request and the response of a recorded call.
capture.headersCount: Label of the headers tab with the number of headers.
capture.selectExchange: Accessible name of the checkbox of a row; {{title}} is the method and path.
capture.selectAll: Accessible name of the checkbox in the table header.
capture.duration: Duration of a call in milliseconds.
capture.destinationLabel: Accessible name of the folder picker.
capture.newFolder: Option that creates a folder named {{name}}.
capture.message: Accessible name of the switch between request and response.
capture.messageSection: Accessible name of the switch between body and headers.
capture.upgraded: A WebSocket upgrade happened during the call.
capture.truncated: 2 MB is the size limit and stays as written.
capture.saveSelected: Button that saves the ticked calls as requests in the chosen folder.
capture.listLabel: Accessible name of the list of calls.
captureAction.fallbackFolderName: Name of the folder (and of saved examples) when the address of the API has no host name. Saved as data.
captureAction.openedTitle: Title of the notice shown when one call was opened as a new request.
captureAction.savedTopLevel: Result message; the top level means outside any folder.
captureAction.savedToFolder: Result message; {{name}} is a folder name.
captureAction.withheld: {{headers}} is a list of header names that were not copied for safety.
captureAction.bodyNote: Reminder shown after saving captured calls.
capture.running: Status label while the capture proxy is running. Adjective, not a command.
capture.port: Label of the field for a network port number.
capture.start: Button that starts the capture proxy. Verb.
capture.stop: Button that stops the capture proxy. Verb.
capture.body: Label above the body of a captured request or response. Noun.
capture.columns.time: Column heading: when the request was captured.
capture.columns.path: Column heading: the URL path of the captured request.
capture.columns.status: Column heading: HTTP status code of the response.
capture.columns.size: Column heading: size of the response.
capture.clear: Button that removes all captured requests from the list. Verb.
